segment_rules._description: UNS+S 'Trennung von Positions- und Summenteil' is Muss on all four use cases (segment 00026), followed by the Summenbetrag MOA+12.
SG3 (Ansprechpartner) is Kann on every use case; COM is Muss only within it (see CTA).
SG3 (Ansprechpartner) is Kann on every use case; [503] only recommends it on an Abweisung. CTA is Muss *within* SG3, so a flat M refuses every conformant REMADV that omits the optional group.
FTX is optional per MIG 2.9e (no AHB constraint for PID 33001)
